summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Nomura Holdings, Inc., a Japanese financial services group, announcing the scheduled date for its first quarter fiscal 2027 operating results release on July 29, 2026. The filing provides the date, time, and availability of financial statements on the company website, along with conference call details. It contains no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or capital return. As a standard earnings announcement, it does not trigger a special situations classification. This non-US filing is mapped to equivalent US routine earnings press release guidance.
